Radar allowed so much for my character arch last year... He allowed so much all around for all players. (Man the stuff we all had seen/been through).. He quickly became a forever DM to me ;) they tell me 'No' allot ... Not because I want something game breaking,  or because I'm being normal me... but because they understood what a character's arch can do for a player. I grew the way I did because of all the glorious DM's last year. This year we have some of the same DM's, and new ones. All of which I had the privilege to play for, and play with (mariam and dmd) last year. Knowing the players, knowing how they spun their stories, I have full faith in whenever any one of them tells me 'No'.... And Noah... Ahhh Noah. A right fine person he is... He knew how to take it to an emotional level with me very quickly. The flashbacks of 3buc's death, and Mello. ❤️. And my honest to god favorite character from last year, Archevist Daysong.... I miss him so much. Rob tho... He lord and master! (Ebuc within will always admire him). My point being... I cant stress enough how happy I am to help out this year as a mod.
